name: Screen design
description: How the assistant lays out its screen: one focus, a few things beside it, small things as chips, urgent things alone. Works on desktop, tablet and phone.

skills.name: screen-design
skills.description: How to lay out the owner's screen with screen.compose: one focus, things beside it, chips, notes and alerts, for desktop, tablet and phone. Use before drawing a screen you have not drawn before.
